description: A Python script implementing a Streamlit-based SQL chatbot interface that interacts with a PostgreSQL database using LangChain and OpenAI APIs. It sets up environment variables, defines tools, and manages user interactions for database querying and conversational responses.

methods.name: count_tokens
methods.description: Processes a user query by combining it with a prompt template, runs it through an LLM chain, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function for the Streamlit app that manages chat interface, user input, and response display.
